era: 殖民印度与南非时期（波尔班达—伦敦—南非21年（1893-1914）—印度独立运动（1915-1948）：凤凰村/托拉斯坦修道院—非合作运动（1920-1922）—盐长征（1930）—退出印度（1942）—印巴分治与遇刺（1948），古吉拉特—约翰内斯堡—萨巴玛蒂—瓦尔达—新德里）
school: 萨提亚格拉哈（satyagraha，真理坚持/真理之力）创立者 + 非暴力不合作（ahimsa + non-cooperation）运动法统 + 自苦感化（tapasya，绝食作为道德压强）实践者 + 建设性纲领（khadi手纺/村社自治/废不可触性/印穆团结）纲领家 + 印度国民大会党实际精神领袖 + 《印度自治》《我体验真理的故事》作者 + 去中心化自治（swaraj=村社共和国）政治经济学家
courtesy_name: 莫罕达斯·卡拉姆昌德·甘地 / '圣雄'（Mahatma，1915年由泰戈尔首称）/ '甘地吉'（Gandhiji，印度通称）/ '巴普'（Bapu，'父亲'，印度民众尊称）/ '南非时期律师先生'（南非印侨早期称呼）/ '萨提亚格拉哈之父'（非暴力抵抗研究界通称）
pseudonym: 无化名；以本名 M. K. Gandhi 署名，其思想多以《印度自治（Hind Swaraj）》（1909）、《我体验真理的故事（An Autobiography or The Story of My Experiments with Truth）》（1927-1929）、《建设性纲领》（1941/1945）、创办的《印度舆论（Indian Opinion）》《青年印度（Young India）》《哈里真（Harijan）》周刊及历年讲演流传
representative_works: 《印度自治（Hind Swaraj / Indian Home Rule）》（1909，伦敦至南非船上11天写成）：批判西方机器文明与现代国家，'自治=村社自足'的政治哲学总纲
《我体验真理的故事》（1927-1929）：以'真理实验'为题的自传——把个人修行写成方法学文本，'手段与目的必须同样纯洁'的原典
南非萨提亚格拉哈首践（1906-1913，约翰内斯堡—德兰士瓦）：反《亚洲法》登记焚证、托兰斯瓦尔矿业罢工——非暴力抵抗方法学的实验室
全国非合作运动（1920-1922）：抵制立法会/法院/学校/英货，把'不服从'第一次升为全国总纲
盐长征（1930-03-12至04-05，萨巴玛蒂至丹迪385公里）：以一把海盐撕碎盐法合法性的符号性公民抗命，使印度问题全球头条化
《建设性纲领》（1941/1945，致国大党）：khadi、村社自治、印穆团结、废不可触性、禁酒等18项建设项——'建设先行于抗争'的治国大纲
1932年反对《 Communal Award》分划贱民选区的绝食至死边缘，逼出《浦那协定》（Poona Pact）——自苦感化改变选举制度的孤例
historical_significance: 甘地（1869-1948），生于古吉拉特卡提阿瓦半岛波尔班达土邦首席大臣之家，1888年18岁赴伦敦学法律，1891年取得律师资格，1893年赴南非处理一桩商务官司却被南非种族制度撞成另一个人——彼得马里茨堡车站被逐出头等车厢之夜，是他从'体面的帝国律师'转向'真理坚持者'的起点。此后二十一年他在南非把'非暴力抵抗'从冲动炼成方法：1906年德兰士瓦《亚洲法》强制印侨登记，他首创 satyagraha 一词（satya真理+agraha坚持），以焚毁登记证、集体入狱回应；1913年矿业印侨大罢工迫使当局部分让步，方法学定型。1915年返印，先以1917年昌帕兰靛蓝农调查、1918年阿默达巴德纺织工罢工（首次以绝食为道德中介）与凯达抗税三役立信，1920年把'不合作'升为全国总纲；1922年乔里·乔拉事件中因示威者烧死22名警察，他以'群众尚未配得上非暴力'为由无限期中止整个运动——这是他方法论最冷峻也最独特的一笔：宁失 momentum，不失方法纯度。1930年盐长征以385公里的步行与一把自制海盐，把经济税率问题转写为全民道德戏剧；1932年为反对把贱民分划出单独选区而绝食至死边，逼出《浦那协定》；1942年'退出印度'把口号推到顶点；1947年印度独立之夜他不在德里庆典而在加尔各答绝食平息教派仇杀；1948年1月30日被印度教极端分子刺杀，以死完成了他最后的论据。其方法论签名有三：一是'手段即目的的种子'——以不义手段求正义之果，收成的必是不义；二是'以自苦代他苦'——把承受苦难而非施加伤害设定为压强机制，唤醒对手良知与国际舆论；三是'建设先于抗争'——khadi 手纺与村社自治把独立从政治事件变成每日可践行的劳作。在 Protreptic 思维体系里，他是'弱者以真理之力翻转强权'的奠基性标杆：民权运动（马丁·路德·金）、反种族隔离（曼德拉）、全球历次非暴力革命皆直接认其为方法之源。
core_thoughts: 萨提亚格拉哈：satya（真理）+agraha（坚持）——对手不是敌人而是'共同错途的受难者'，抗争的目的是唤醒而非消灭
非暴力（ahimsa）：不是软弱而是最高纪律——非暴力者与暴力者同样勇敢，且须更勇敢
手段与目的的同一性：'目的之不义的手段会毒化所求之果'——不义手段永不能成正果
自苦（tapasya）：以承受苦难替代施加伤害——绝食是把冲突内化为自己身体上的赌注
盐与纺车：把政治化为日常——人人可制的盐、人人可纺的纱，使'参与独立'无需财富与武器
村社自治（swaraj）：独立不是换一面旗，而是七十万村庄的自足与自尊——'真正的印度在村庄'
印穆团结与废不可触性：统一战线的两条道德试金石——不能团结最不可团结者，则独立只是换主子
批评与自我批评：运动自身的暴力是内部道德失败——1922年乔里·乔拉后主动中止全国运动
守法者的犯法：公开、认罪、入狱——公民抗命的合法性来自'愿意承受法律后果'
真理实验：真理不是占有物而是渐近线——'我只是声称自己走在寻找真理的路上'
蛰伏积势：敌强我弱时以合法、局部、可撤回的行动积累道义资本——南非21年即是总攻前的蓄力期
famous_quote: '以眼还眼，只会让全世界都盲。'（An eye for an eye makes the whole world blind.）；'首先他们无视你，然后嘲笑你，然后与你战斗，然后你胜利。'（First they ignore you...）；'成为你想在世界上看到的改变。'（Be the change you wish to see in the world.——出自其思想转述）；'手段即目的之种子。'（The means may be likened to a seed, the end to a tree.——Hind Swaraj）；'非暴力是弱者不可为的强者的武器。'
influence: 甘地的影响以四波扩散：第一波在南非与印度（1893-1948），把非暴力从道德直觉炼成可复制的抗争工程学——南非实验产出方法，印度战场完成全国化验证，使一个没有军队、没有财团的律师集团瓦解了日不落帝国的统治合法性；第二波在全球民权（1950s-1980s），马丁·路德·金明言其方法直接师承甘地，曼德拉承认非暴力阶段受其塑造，波兰团结工会、菲律宾人民力量、捷克天鹅绒革命均可闻其回声——'以自苦唤醒良知'成为二十世纪弱势者抗争的标准语法；第三波在政治哲学与和平研究（至今），《印度自治》对机器文明与现代国家的批判滋养了去增长（degrowth）、社群主义与甘地主义经济学（John Ruskin《Unto This Last》的回应、E. F. Schumacher《小即是美》引其为先声），乔姆斯基、阿伦特等皆以'甘地式非暴力为何有效'为理论题；第四波在冲突治理与公民社会方法论（至今），'非暴力纪律'成为国际NGO训练手册的常设科目，其'运动自身失范即中止'的纪律观被视为公民抗命区别于暴乱的定义性判据。在 Protreptic 思维体系里，甘地是'德力两极'中德的一极：韩非以力立秩序，甘地以真理立秩序——他把'弱者的劣势'（无武装、无财团、无选票）系统性地转化为优势（道德可见度、参与门槛为零、国际舆论杠杆），并把'手段-目的同一性'从道德格言升级为可操作的方法论约束。他不是没有对手的批评：安贝德卡斥其崇村庄掩盖了村社内部压迫，尼赫鲁嫌其经济浪漫主义，历史学家质疑他对乔里·乔拉的担责方式——这些批评已收进 caveats，恰使其档案保持方法论中性。

modes.name_zh: 萨提亚格拉哈真理坚持法
modes.definition_zh: 把对抗的重心从'压倒对手'改写为'唤醒对手'：satya（真理）+agraha（坚持），即以对真理的执着替代对武力的执着——对手不是敌人，而是'同陷错途的受难者'；抗争的目标不是消灭他，而是让他看见共同错在哪。要害有三：其一，真理先行——任何行动之前先确认自己站在可验证、可公开陈述的真相一边，撒谎一次则 satyagraha 整体作废；其二，对手非敌——把对手当作要转化（convert）而非击败（defeat）的对象，故胜利的定义是'对手心服'而非'对手屈服'；其三，自愿受苦——以自己承受代价（入狱、没收、绝食）而非让对手付出代价来显示真理的分量，苦难成为论证本身。方法论签名：弱者的力量不由刀剑担保，而由'我愿为此真理先赴苦'的可信度担保——真理不是喊出来的，是以身试出来的。
modes.definition_en: Satyagraha rewrites the very objective of an unequal contest: not to overpower the opponent but to awaken him. Gandhi coined the word from satya (truth) and agraha (holding firmly) in South Africa in 1906, deliberately rejecting 'passive resistance' as too negative—the practitioner does not resist passively; he adheres to truth actively, and the opponent is not an enemy but a fellow human being trapped in the same error, to be converted rather than defeated. Three disciplines give the mode its force. First, truth before action: before any campaign the actor must verify, and be willing to state publicly and testably, that his side stands on facts—one deliberate lie voids the entire method, because the whole apparatus runs on credibility rather than coercion. Second, the opponent is convertible: victory is defined as the opponent's own conscience conceding, not his will being crushed, which is why Gandhi sought settlements—like the Gandhi-Irwin Pact—that let the adversary walk away with dignity intact. Third, voluntary suffering is the argument: instead of making the opponent pay a price, the satyagrahi absorbs one—jail, confiscation, fasting—so the visible cost of holding truth becomes the proof of truth; suffering is not collateral damage but the medium of persuasion itself. This inverts the standard logic of power: the weak, lacking armies and treasuries, possess in their own bodies a currency the strong cannot counterfeit—the willingness to lose for what is true. Signature: the weak do not borrow force; they spend credibility—and suffering freely accepted is the only proof of conviction that no treasury can purchase and no bayonet can refute.
modes.source_chapter: 《印度自治》（1909）；《我体验真理的故事》第二卷（南非章）；Hind Swaraj '手段与目的'章：'The means may be likened to a seed, the end to a tree'
process_zh: 真相核验：行动前把己方事实陈述写清、公开、可验——凡经不起对账的诉求立即撤回
对象转化：把对手定位为'需被唤醒的共同受难者'而非敌人，为每一轮对抗预留心服的出口
以身试理：不向对手索取代价，而自愿承担入狱、没收、绝食等代价，让承受本身成为论证
心服收官：胜利以对手良知认可为准（谈判、让步、修法），不以单方面屈服为终点
process_en: Verify truth first: state your facts publicly and testably; withdraw any claim that fails an open audit
Frame the opponent as convertible: a fellow sufferer to be awakened, never an enemy—leave a face-saving exit in every round
Pay the price yourself: absorb jail, confiscation, fasting instead of inflicting cost—endurance becomes the argument
Close on conversion: victory is the opponent's conscience conceding (settlement, reform, repeal), not one-sided surrender
modes.key_quote_zh: 真理之力不是压倒对手，而是唤醒对手——我愿先于任何人承受这真理的代价。
modes.key_quote_en: The force of truth does not crush the opponent; it awakens him—I accept the cost of truth before anyone else must.
representative_cases_zh: 1906年德兰士瓦反《亚洲法》：印侨集会焚毁登记证，甘地首创 satyagraha 之名——以'自愿入狱'替代'服从恶法'，八年间数千人入狱而运动声誉愈高
1930年盐长征：以一把自制海盐公开犯盐法、随即写信告知总督即将犯法——'守法者公开犯法并认罪'把合法性辩证法推到极致
反例警示：若'真理'一端掺假（如印度教徒借运动夹带教派私怨），整个方法反噬自身——1947-48年教派仇杀正是真理之名被私用后方法的自我瓦解，甘地以最后绝食与自己的生命为方法付账
representative_cases_en: Transvaal, 1906: Indians publicly burned registration certificates and accepted mass imprisonment—thousands jailed over eight years, and the movement's credibility rose with every sentence served

The Salt March, 1930: Gandhi announced to the Viceroy in writing that he would commit the crime, then committed it before witnesses—one pinch of home-made salt turned legality itself into the defendant

Counterexample: when the 'truth' side smuggles in private grievance (sectarian hatred inside the movement), the method consumes itself—the 1947-48 killings were exactly this failure, and Gandhi paid for the method with his last fast and his life

modes.definition_zh: 把'不合作'从情绪化的抵制升级为一门有纪律的工程学：ahimsa（不害）不是消极不动，而是对暴力手段的绝对禁运——同时以成千上万普通人'撤回合作'来冻结统治机器的运转：不买英货、不上法院、不进官办学校、不受封号。统治依赖被治者的配合，撤回配合即是最深的合法性质疑。要害有三：其一，非暴力是纪律不是天性——受训者须事先宣誓、演练挨打不还手，'非暴力者与暴力者同样勇敢且须更勇敢'；其二，不合作有梯度——从退还封号、抵制英货到抗税，按训练程度递进，未受训者不得参与高危层级；其三，合作是权力的来源这一判断把斗争场从战场挪到日常——每个消费者、学生、律师都天然握有武器。方法论签名：统治机器每转一圈都要有人上油——不合作者不发一枪，只拒绝再上油；机器越大，断油越致命。
modes.definition_en: Non-cooperation upgrades boycott from an outburst of anger into a disciplined engineering of withdrawal: ahimsa (non-injury) is not passivity but a total embargo on violent means, exercised alongside the mass refusal of cooperation that keeps any regime running—buy no foreign cloth, staff no courts, attend no official schools, accept no titles. Every government, Gandhi argued, rests on the cooperation of the governed; withdraw the cooperation and the deepest question of legitimacy is posed without a single shot. Three disciplines carry the mode. First, non-violence is a drill, not a temperament: volunteers take vows beforehand and rehearse taking blows without returning them, because 'the non-violent are as brave as the violent—braver,' and an untrained crowd is a mob that will convert boycott into riot within an hour. Second, non-cooperation is graduated: from returning honors and boycotting goods up through tax refusal, each rung demands a higher level of training, and participants below the required grade are barred from the dangerous rungs—escalation is rationed by preparation. Third, the premise that cooperation is the source of power moves the battlefield into ordinary life: every consumer, student, and lawyer already holds the weapon, which is why a movement of spinners and school-boycotters could shake an empire with no arsenal at all. At its 1920-22 peak the campaign made colonial courts, councils, and cloth markets visibly malfunction across a subcontinent. Signature: every machine needs someone to oil it—cooperators fire no shot; they simply stop oiling, and the larger the machine, the more fatal the drought.
modes.source_chapter: 《青年印度》周刊（1920-1922年非合作运动期间的系列训示）；《我体验真理的故事》第五部非合作运动章；1920年国大党那格浦尔大会非合作决议
process_zh: 权力断源：先画出统治机器的'合作依赖清单'（货、法、学、衔、税），选定普通人零门槛可断的一环
训练在前：参与者先宣誓受训——挨打不还手、不侮辱对手、不藏武器，未受训者不得上场
梯度升级：从低危（退衔抵货）到高危（抗税抗命）逐级放行，每级以训练度为准入门槛
违纪即停：任何暴力出轨立即中止相应行动并公开担责——纪律是方法的氧气，断氧即熄火
process_en: Map the cooperation supply: list what the machine needs from the governed—goods, courts, schools, titles, taxes—and pick the link any citizen can cut at zero cost
Train before marching: vows and drills—take blows without returning them, insult no opponent, carry no weapon; the untrained stay home
Ratchet by gradient: release rungs from low-risk (titles, imports) to high-risk (tax refusal) gated by training level—escalation rationed by preparation
Halt on breach: any violent lapse suspends the action and is owned publicly—discipline is the method's oxygen; cut it and the fire dies
modes.key_quote_zh: 非暴力不是弱者的遮羞布，而是比暴力更难的纪律——不发一枪，让机器自己停转。
modes.key_quote_en: Non-violence is not the weak man's excuse but the harder discipline—fire no shot, and let the machine stall on its own.
representative_cases_zh: 1920-1922年全国非合作运动：律师退庭、学生退学、封号退还、洋布当街焚烧——殖民体系的法院与市场在数月内功能性瘫痪，国大党从精英沙龙变成百万人的组织
受训者演练：运动前国大党志愿队在 ashram 内演练'静立挨打'——把挨打不还手从德性练成肌肉记忆，这是运动能撑八个月不失控的技术前提
反例警示：1922年乔里·乔拉——未受训群众把示威变成纵火，烧死22名警察，甘地当日宣布无限期中止整个全国运动——不合作的每一分威力都以纪律为前提，纪律失守则威力转为反噬
representative_cases_en: Non-cooperation, 1920-22: lawyers left courts, students left schools, titles were returned, foreign cloth burned in the streets—colonial courts and markets visibly seized, and the Congress became a mass organization of millions

The drills: volunteer squads rehearsed standing still under blows inside the ashrams—turning 'take the beating, return none' from virtue into muscle memory, the technical precondition for eight months without collapse

Counterexample: Chauri Chaura, 1922—an untrained crowd torched a police station, killing 22 officers; Gandhi halted the entire national movement within days. Every unit of non-cooperation's power is mortgaged to discipline; when discipline fails, the power flips into backlash

modes.definition_zh: 把冲突的代价从对手身上移到自己身上：tapasya（自苦）以绝食为最高形式——不强迫、不威胁，只把自己的生命押在论点之上，让'我为此真理而死'的可见性成为对手良知与国际舆论无法卸载的压强。要害有三：其一，绝食是对自己人的武器——甘地明言绝食不能用来迫使敌人就范，只能针对'与自己有情感纽带者'（同志、同教、被统治者），因为其机理是爱的债而非力的压；其二，先礼后苦——绝食前必先穷尽说理、谈判、请愿，且把理由、诉求、期限全部公开，使自苦可被检验而非表演；其三，不成功便成仁的真诚度由历史担保——1932年反对分划贱民选区的绝食推进至濒死，逼出《浦那协定》，制度为此改写。方法论签名：把账单开给自己——当对手看见你已把自己逼到墙角，他面对的不再是威胁而是镜子：不公若继续，他将被写进你倒下的那一页。
modes.definition_en: Tapasya moves the price of a conflict off the opponent and onto oneself: fasting is its highest form—no force, no threat, only one's own life staked on the claim, so that the visible readiness to die becomes a pressure no opponent's conscience and no international audience can unload. Three disciplines make it work rather than theatrical. First, the fast is a weapon aimed at one's own side: Gandhi insisted a fast must never coerce an enemy, only those bound to him by ties of love or duty—comrades, co-religionists, his own people—because its mechanism is the debt of love, not the leverage of force; fasting at an adversary is blackmail, fasting before one's own is testimony. Second, persuasion first, suffering last: every fast followed exhausted reasoning, negotiation, and petition, with the reasons, the demand, and the deadline published in advance so the self-suffering is auditable rather than staged—a fast without a stated, narrow, rescindable condition is suicide, not method. Third, sincerity is vouched for by history, not rhetoric: the 1932 fast against separate electorates for the Depressed Classes was carried to the edge of death until the Poona Pact rewrote the electoral arrangement; the willingness to go through with it was what converted moral theater into constitutional fact. The mode converts the weakest body into the strongest instrument: hunger is a resource the poorest can mint, and unlike violence it cannot be answered with counter-violence—only with conscience or with the humiliation of watching a man die. Signature: bill yourself first—when the opponent sees you have cornered yourself, he faces not a threat but a mirror: if the injustice continues, history will record it on the page where you fell.
modes.source_chapter: 《青年印度》与《哈里真》周刊历次绝食声明（1918阿默达巴德、1932浦那、1943、1948德里）；《我体验真理的故事》绝食章
process_zh: 穷尽说理：绝食前把谈判、请愿、公开辩论全部走完——自苦是最后手段而非开场白
限定对象：只对'与自己有情感/义务纽带者'绝食（同志、同教、本国民众），不对敌人做胁迫
公示条款：把理由、具体诉求、解除条件、期限全部公开，使绝食可审计、可叫停、不可诬为表演
以身践诺：把承受推进到真实不可逆（濒死亦不破例），让对手面对'良知或耻辱'的二元选择
process_en: Exhaust persuasion first: negotiation, petition, and public argument completed before any fast—self-suffering is the last resort, never the opener
Aim at your own: fast only against those bound to you by love or obligation—never as coercion of an enemy
Publish the terms: reasons, exact demand, rescission conditions, and deadline made public so the fast is auditable and cannot be smeared as theater
Make it real: carry the suffering past the point of no return—even to the edge of death—leaving the opponent a binary of conscience or shame
modes.key_quote_zh: 绝食的矛头永远向内——我以自己的饥饿向自己的同胞讨要他们的良知。
modes.key_quote_en: The fast always points inward—with my own hunger I call my own people to their conscience.
representative_cases_zh: 1918年阿默达巴德纺织工罢工：资方是甘地一向敬重的资本家朋友，他第一次以绝食（针对自己人）介入劳资之争，工友加薪35%——'绝食不对敌人'的首次立规
1932年反分划贱民选区绝食：英国《 Communal Award》拟为贱民设单独选区，甘地认为这会永久割裂印度社会，绝食至濒死，印度教领袖与安贝德卡谈判出《浦那协定》——一次绝食改写选举制度
反例警示：绝食被滥用为政治表演时即失效——后世政客频频'绝食抗议'而限期含糊、条件漂浮，公众迅速审美疲劳；甘地的绝食之所以从未沦为表演，正因条款公开、对象限定、且每次都真实走向濒死
representative_cases_en: Ahmedabad mill strike, 1918: Gandhi's first fast, aimed at mill owners he counted as friends, ended with a 35% wage rise—the rule 'never fast against an enemy' established in its first use
The fast against separate electorates, 1932: carried to the brink of death until the Poona Pact rewrote the electoral settlement—one fast redrawing a constitution

Counterexample: fasts become theater when terms are vague—later imitators 'hunger-strike' with floating demands and soft deadlines, and audiences fatigue fast; Gandhi's fasts never did, because terms were published, targets bounded, and each one genuinely approached death

modes.domain_en: Strategy of the Weak / Moral-Capital Accumulation
modes.definition_zh: 敌强我弱时不急于总攻，而以合法、局部、可撤回的小步行动系统性地积累三样弱者唯一能积累的资本：案例（每次小胜都是方法与正当性的公开演示）、组织（每次行动训练出一批受过纪律淬炼的骨干）、声誉（对'守法与诚信'的长期自持使日后更大的不服从自带合法性）。南非二十一年即是教科书式的蛰伏期：从1894年成立纳塔尔印度人大会递请愿，到1906年才第一次主动犯法，中间12年只做合法积蓄。要害有三：其一，蛰伏不是无所作为而是定向积蓄——每一步都写进方法学档案（甘地在《印度舆论》上持续刊载实验记录）；其二，'可撤回'是试错的前提——小步行动保持随时可停，失败不透支信用；其三，升级有时点判据：当对手以更大压迫回应合法请愿（1906《亚洲法》），即是道义资本足以支撑'公开犯法'的信号。方法论签名：弱者打不起总攻，但每一场小仗都在为最后的总攻存本钱——存的是案例、骨干与声誉，这三样火种越积，火才烧得越旺。
modes.definition_en: When the enemy is strong and you are weak, do not rush the general offensive; instead accumulate—through legal, local, retractable small actions—the only three forms of capital a weak side can build: cases (every small victory is a public demonstration of method and legitimacy), cadres (every action trains a batch of discipline-hardened organizers), and reputation (long self-restraint within the law makes later, larger disobedience arrive pre-legitimized). Gandhi's twenty-one years in South Africa are the textbook latent phase: from founding the Natal Indian Congress and petitioning in 1894 to the first deliberate law-breaking only in 1906, twelve years of purely legal accumulation preceded the first satyagraha. Three disciplines govern the accumulation. First, latency is directed, not dormant: every step is logged—his paper Indian Opinion functioned as a running lab notebook of experiments, so each small campaign compounded method rather than merely mood. Second, retractability is the precondition of trial and error: small steps stay stoppable at any point, so failures cost attention but never credit. Third, escalation has a trigger test: when the opponent answers legal petition with heavier repression (the 1906 Asiatic Registration Act), that response is the signal that accumulated moral capital can now underwrite open defiance—escalate on the opponent's escalation, not on one's own impatience. When Gandhi returned to India in 1915, he spent his first years in local campaigns—Champaran, Ahmedabad, Kheda—precisely to re-run the accumulation loop on the national stage before the 1920 general offensive. Signature: the weak cannot afford a general offensive, but every skirmish deposits principal for it—cases, cadres, and reputation are the kindling; the larger the pile, the hotter the final fire.
modes.source_chapter: 《我体验真理的故事》南非各章（1893-1914）；《印度舆论》历年实验记录；1917昌帕兰调查与1918凯达抗税（返印后的再蓄力）
key_concepts: 以对手升级为升级信号
process_zh: 小步定标：以合法、局部、可撤回为约束，设计每一步小行动并预先写明其要积累的是案例还是骨干还是声誉
档案化：每次行动的过程、结果、教训持续公开刊载，使个人经验升为可复制的方法学
守边界蓄信：长期严格守法与守诺，为日后更大的不服从预存合法性
以对手升级定升级：当对手以压迫回应合法请愿时，才把道义资本兑换为公开犯法的下一阶段
process_en: Design small steps: legal, local, retractable—each step pre-declared as building cases, cadres, or reputation
Log everything: publish process, outcome, and lessons continuously so private experience compounds into transferable method
Bank credibility: long strict law-abidingness pre-legitimizes the larger disobedience to come
Escalate on the opponent's escalation: convert moral capital into open defiance only when repression answers legal petition
modes.key_quote_zh: 弱者存不了军火，但存得了火种——每一场小仗存下的案例、骨干与声誉，就是总攻那天的燃料。
modes.key_quote_en: The weak cannot stockpile arms, but they can stockpile kindling—cases, cadres, and reputation banked from every small fight are the fuel of the final offensive.
representative_cases_zh: 南非蛰伏期（1894-1906）：纳塔尔印度人大会、连年请愿、出版《印度舆论》——12年纯合法积蓄，1906年《亚洲法》出台时方法、组织、声誉三资本同时到位
返印再蓄力（1915-1920）：昌帕兰靛蓝农调查、阿默达巴德罢工、凯达抗税三役皆以'调查-谈判-有限行动'小步开局，为1920全国总攻试出干部与信度
反例警示：过早总攻透支信用——若1906年前仓促犯法，印侨将被定性为'闹事暴民'而非'守法者的绝望'；蛰伏期的本质是让'犯法'这一步在被看见时自带清白
representative_cases_en: The South African latency, 1894-1906: the Natal Indian Congress, years of petitions, the founding of Indian Opinion—twelve purely legal years so that when the 1906 Act arrived, method, organization, and reputation arrived with it
Re-accumulation in India, 1915-20: Champaran, Ahmedabad, Kheda each began with inquiry-negotiation-limited action, testing cadres and credibility before the 1920 national offensive

Counterexample: a premature offensive overdrafts credit—law-breaking before 1906 would have cast Indians as rioters rather than law-abiding men driven to despair; latency exists so that defiance arrives pre-cleansed

modes.definition_zh: 把运动自身的失范当作最高级的纠错信号：群众中出现暴力，不是'被煽动的外部事件'，而是运动内部道德训练的失败——追责先向内。1922年乔里·乔拉示威者烧死22名警察，甘地当月宣布无限期中止整个全国非合作运动并公开自责：宁可交还已到手的政治 momentum，也不让方法在带病的肌体上继续。要害有三：其一，标准内化——非暴力纪律是运动的'存在理由'而非'可谈判的策略选项'，故纪律失守即停机检修，而非'下不为例'；其二，以公开忏悔替代内部甩锅——甘地多次公开自认早期对非洲人的种族偏见、自承实验失败，把个人过失摆上公共检视台，使纠错成为组织的示范行为；其三，纠错的代价由领导者先付——中止运动的最大损失落在甘地个人声望上，他先担，骨干才敢效仿。方法论签名：宁可停摆，不可带病运转——运动的信用不是由胜利养大，而是由'失范即自罚'养大的。
modes.definition_en: Treat a movement's own lapses as its highest-grade error signal: when violence breaks out among the people, it is not an externally instigated incident but a failure of the movement's internal moral training—accountability points inward first. When demonstrators burned a police station at Chauri Chaura in February 1922 and 22 officers died, Gandhi suspended the entire national non-cooperation movement within the month and confessed his own responsibility publicly: he would rather hand back a political momentum already in hand than let the method run on a diseased body. Three disciplines define the practice. First, the standard is constitutive, not tactical: non-violent discipline is the movement's reason for being, not a negotiable option—so a breach means halt-and-repair, never 'don't let it happen again.' Second, public confession replaces internal blame-shifting: Gandhi repeatedly owned his early racial prejudice toward Africans and his failed 'experiments,' placing personal faults on the public examination table so that self-correction became the organization's demonstrated behavior rather than its hidden etiquette. Third, the leader pays the correction's price first: suspending the movement cost Gandhi more personal prestige than anyone—he absorbed that cost before asking cadres to follow, which is exactly why they could. Compare the standard revolutionary grammar, where violence is blamed on provocateurs and discipline is enforced by tribunal; Gandhi inverts both: no external scapegoats, no punitive machinery—only the movement's own willingness to stop itself. Signature: better to stand down than to run sick—the credit of a movement is grown not by its victories but by its readiness to punish itself.
modes.source_chapter: 1922年2月甘地《停止非合作运动》公告与《青年印度》自责文章；乔里·乔拉事件审判记录；《我体验真理的故事》中自陈南非早期种族偏见段落
process_zh: 标准立宪：把非暴力纪律写为运动的存在条件而非策略选项——违纪即触发停机，而非扣分
追责向内：群众暴力发生，先检讨训练、组织与期望管理，禁止'外部煽动'叙事
公开自罚：领导者公开承担并说明纠错代价（中止、绝食、自责），把纠错变成示范行为
复训重启：停摆期间完成纪律复训与组织净化后，方可重启行动——重启以'合格'而非'平静'为准
process_en: Constitutionalize the standard: write non-violent discipline as the movement's condition of existence—a breach triggers shutdown, not a demerit
Point accountability inward: after crowd violence, audit training, organization, and expectation management first; ban the 'agent provocateur' narrative
Punish in public: the leader openly owns the correction and its cost (suspension, fast, confession), turning self-correction into demonstrated behavior
Restart on qualification, not calm: resume only after retraining and organizational cleansing—'qualified,' not merely 'quiet'
modes.key_quote_zh: 群众尚未配得上非暴力——我宁可中止运动，也不让方法在失守的纪律上继续。
modes.key_quote_en: The people are not yet ready for non-violence—I would rather suspend the movement than let the method run on broken discipline.
representative_cases_zh: 乔里·乔拉（1922）：22名警察死于纵火，甘地数日内宣布无限期中止全国非合作运动，此后转入建设性纲领与纺车运动——纠错把运动从'政治总攻'切换为'道德重建'而非瓦解
自传式忏悔（1927-1929）：甘地在《我体验真理的故事》中公开自陈南非早年对非洲黑人的偏见表述与多次'实验失败'——把领袖过失写进永久公共档案，史所罕见
反例警示：把'担责'做成话术则适得其反——只中止不检讨训练、只忏悔不改变组织行为，群众会精确识别'道德表演'；乔里·乔拉后甘地同步完成了复训与战略切换，担责才是完整的
representative_cases_en: Chauri Chaura, 1922: 22 policemen dead, the national movement suspended within days, energy redirected into the constructive programme—correction switched the campaign from offensive to moral rebuilding instead of collapse
The confessional autobiography, 1927-29: Gandhi published his early racial prejudice and failed experiments in permanent public record—almost unheard of for a living leader

Counterexample: accountability as rhetoric backfires—suspension without retraining, confession without behavioral change reads as theater; Gandhi paired Chauri Chaura with retraining and strategic pivot, which is what made the accountability whole

modes.definition_zh: 黏合一个被宗教、种姓、阶级、语言切碎的社会，靠的不是利益交换与封官许愿，而是一组所有人都无法拒绝的道德规范：印穆团结、废不可触性、禁酒、khadi 自足——'最不可团结者'（穆斯林、贱民）被设为统一战线的前提而非战利品。同时把'对手'精确切分：英帝国政府是被反对的对象，英国人民与良知不是——'不合作的是制度，不是民族'，这为国际舆论与对手内部的良知力量留出通道。要害有三：其一，黏合剂必须高于各方私利——真理与非暴力是印度教徒、穆斯林、无神论者都能进入的公约数；其二，把道德试金石摆在阵线入口——拒绝与贱民同桌者不得成为运动的领导者，统一战线的纯度由入口把关；其三，'分化对手'以瓦解其合法性叙事为主：把'帝国对臣民'改写为'良知对不义'，使镇压在道义上自我贬值。方法论签名：用利益粘起来的阵线利尽则散，用规范粘起来的阵线利尽不散——把最不可团结者放在第一位，阵线才有资格谈团结。
modes.definition_en: To hold together a society fragmented by religion, caste, class, and language, do not rely on patronage and bargains; rely on a set of moral norms no party can refuse: Hindu-Muslim unity, the abolition of untouchability, temperance, khadi self-reliance—with the 'least unitable' (Muslims, the Depressed Classes) placed as the front's premise, not its spoils. Meanwhile, split the opponent with surgical precision: the British imperial government is the object of opposition, the British people and conscience are not—'we non-cooperate with the system, not the nation,' leaving a channel open for international opinion and for conscience inside the adversary's own camp. Three disciplines carry the mode. First, the adhesive must stand above every faction's private interest: truth and non-violence are the common denominator into which Hindus, Muslims, and atheists can all walk. Second, the moral touchstone sits at the front's entrance: a leader who refuses to dine with an untouchable is disqualified—the front's purity is gated at admission, not audited after victory. Third, 'divide the opponent' means dismantling his legitimacy narrative: reframe 'empire versus subjects' as 'conscience versus injustice,' so every act of repression devalues the repressor morally even when it wins tactically. In practice the front held landlords (Patel), modernists (Nehru), industrialists (Birla), and village masses inside one discipline, and its 1932 defense of Depressed Classes' interests even forced a constitutional revision. Signature: fronts glued by interest scatter when interest ends; fronts glued by norm do not—put the least unitable first, and only then does the front earn the word 'unity.'
modes.source_chapter: 《建设性纲领》第2-4项（印穆团结、废不可触性、禁酒）；1920年代《青年印度》统一战线系列文章；1931年第二轮圆桌会议声明
process_zh: 立公约数：提炼高于各派私利的共享规范（真理、非暴力、最低尊严），作为阵线的宪法条款
入口把关：把'善待最边缘者'（贱民、少数教派）设为参与与领导资格的门槛，纯度在入口而非事后
切分对手：把对手政府与其人民、良知切开，对前者不合作、对后者始终留门
维护优先级：教派或种姓冲突爆发时，统一战线的维护优先于战役推进——宁缓十战，不裂阵线
process_en: Draft the common denominator: shared norms above factional interest (truth, non-violence, minimum dignity) as the front's constitutional clauses
Gate at the entrance: make treatment of the most marginal (untouchables, minorities) a qualification for membership and leadership—purity at admission, not audit after victory
Split the opponent: separate the adversary's government from its people and conscience—non-cooperate with the former, keep the door open to the latter
Front over campaign: when sectarian or caste conflict erupts, maintaining the front outranks advancing any battle—slow ten campaigns rather than crack the front
modes.key_quote_zh: 检验统一战线的不是我们能联合多少人，而是我们把最不可团结者放在了第几位。
modes.key_quote_en: The test of a united front is not how many we can unite, but whom we put first—the least unitable.
representative_cases_zh: 印穆团结纲领（1919-1922）：基拉法运动与不合作运动合流，甘地以'哈里发的荣辱即印度的荣辱'把穆斯林群众首次拉进全国政治——尽管后来分裂，阵线逻辑本身成为范式
哈里真运动（1932-1934）：为贱民奔走改称'哈里真（神之子）'、亲入贱民村落、绝食逼出《浦那协定》——把阵线入口的道德试金石推成宪法修改
反例警示：规范黏合也有极限——1947年印穆大规模仇杀证明，当暴力贯穿双方社会肌理时，道德公约数会被民族主义叙事碾碎；甘地以最后绝食与遇刺为这一极限付了账，阵线法不能替代社会和解工程
representative_cases_en: Hindu-Muslim front, 1919-22: the Khilafat cause merged into non-cooperation, bringing Muslim masses into national politics for the first time—though it later split, the front's logic became the paradigm
The Harijan campaign, 1932-34: renaming the Depressed Classes 'children of God,' living in their villages, and fasting out the Poona Pact—the entrance touchstone pushed into constitutional revision

Counterexample: normative glue has limits—the 1947 massacres showed that when violence runs through both societies, the moral denominator is ground down by nationalist narratives; Gandhi paid for that limit with his last fast and his assassination—the front method cannot replace social reconciliation engineering

modes.domain_zh: 群众动员/日常劳作参与
modes.domain_en: Mass Mobilization / Participation through Daily Labor
modes.definition_zh: 把最大的政治动作分装进最小的日常动作：手纺 khadi 不是经济政策而是参与制度——人人有纺车，则人人每天都能'为独立纺半小时纱'，政治参与不再需要识字、资产与胆量，只需要一双手。这同时解决了运动的三大瓶颈：动员规模（百万文盲农妇也能上场）、经济造血（洋布抵制需要国产替代）、纪律养成（日复一日的纺纱是耐性与集体的日常操练）。要害有三：其一，参与零门槛——把'为国效力'从士大夫专利改成每个身体的日常动作；其二，劳作即宣誓——穿上土布就是穿上了立场，消费行为变成政治表态且无需发言；其三，从群众痛点反推方案——khadi、村社自治、禁酒皆来自纺妇、农户、贱民的真实处境而非会议室推演，'方案在村庄里'。方法论签名：不要问群众能否理解纲领——把纲领裁成一只只纺锤，让他们在手上的节奏里理解它；参与即教育，纺车即讲台。
modes.definition_en: Package the largest political act into the smallest daily one: hand-spinning khadi is not an economic policy but a participation mechanism—give everyone a spinning wheel and everyone can 'spin half an hour for independence' every day; political participation no longer requires literacy, property, or daring, only a pair of hands. This dissolves the movement's three hardest bottlenecks at once: mobilization scale (millions of illiterate village women can join), economic viability (boycotting foreign cloth demands a domestic substitute), and discipline formation (daily spinning is a standing drill in patience and collective rhythm). Three disciplines make it work. First, zero-threshold participation: 'serving the nation' is converted from a literati privilege into a bodily routine anyone can perform—when participation is frictionless, mobilization ceases to be the scarce resource. Second, labor is the oath: wearing homespun is wearing a position; consumption becomes political statement without a single speech, and because the act is repeated daily, commitment is renewed daily rather than spent once at a rally. Third, programs are reverse-engineered from the people's pain points: khadi, village self-rule, and temperance all grew out of the actual condition of spinners, peasants, and the Depressed Classes—not out of conference-room deduction; by 1940 Gandhi's own accounting recorded 275,000 villagers earning over Rs. 34 lakh through the wheel, a working audit that the 'program was found in the village.' Compare the demagogue's mass rally, where participation is emotional and evaporates by morning; the wheel's participation is manual, verifiable, and cumulative—it leaves cloth on the table. Signature: never ask whether the masses can understand the program—cut the program into spindles and let them understand it in the rhythm of their hands; participation is education, and the wheel is the podium.
modes.source_chapter: 《建设性纲领》第1项（khadi 与村社工业）；《印度自治》'文明'章对机器文明的批判；甘地《自传》'纺车'诸章
process_zh: 痛点反推：深入最底层（纺妇、农户、贱民）收集真实处境，从痛点反推可参与的方案而非从理念推演
裁成日常：把宏大目标拆成零门槛、可每日重复的小动作（纺纱、织布、戒酒、教一个字）
劳作即表态：让消费与穿戴承担政治表态功能——无需发言即可立场，无需集会即可累积
账目回验：定期公布参与与产出数据（人数、纱量、收入），使'群众路线'可审计而非口号
process_en: Reverse-engineer from pain points: gather the real condition of the lowest (spinners, peasants, the Depressed Classes) and derive participable programs from it, not from ideology
Cut into daily form: break grand goals into zero-threshold, repeatable daily acts (spin, weave, abstain, teach one word)
Let labor speak: make consumption and dress carry the political statement—position without speech, accumulation without rally
Audit the line: publish participation and output figures (heads, yarn, income) so the mass line stays auditable rather than rhetorical
modes.key_quote_zh: 把独立裁成半小时的纺纱——让一亿双手先于任何条约完成它。
modes.key_quote_en: Cut independence into half-hours of spinning—let a hundred million hands finish it before any treaty does.
representative_cases_zh: khadi 运动（1918-1947）：土布从救济品变成制服与国旗的材质，国大党员皆着 khadi；1940年甘地记录27.5万村民经纺车获得 Rs.34,85,609——参与规模与经济造血同时可审计
盐长征（1930）：'人人可以制盐'与'人人可以纺纱'同构——把垄断品拆成零门槛动作，正是发动385公里步行与全国抗法的参与逻辑
反例警示：把群众参与降为表演性集会则退化为'群众的狂热'——集会式动员情绪当天蒸发，而纺车的参与可验证、可累计、可复盘；凡只造声势不造制度入口的动员，皆是本方法的反面教材
representative_cases_en: The khadi movement, 1918-47: homespun became the material of uniform and flag; by 1940 Gandhi's ledger showed 275,000 villagers earning Rs. 34.86 lakh through the wheel—scale and viability both auditable

The Salt March, 1930: 'everyone can make salt' is structurally the same move as 'everyone can spin'—breaking a monopoly into a zero-threshold act powered 385 kilometers of walking and nationwide defiance

Counterexample: mass participation degraded into rally-theater evaporates by morning—the wheel's participation is verifiable, cumulative, and reviewable; mobilization that manufactures only noise and no institutional entrance is this method's mirror-opposite

modes.definition_zh: 把'独立'定义为可提前交付的现实而非等待批准的未来：swaraj（自治）不是接管德里，而是七十万村庄此刻即可开始的自足——khadi 生产、村社自治机构、基础教育、卫生、禁酒、废不可触性、印穆团结……《建设性纲领》列出十余项'不等宗主国批准就能做'的建设项，使独立从谈判桌上的悬案变成村庄里的既成事实。要害有三：其一，建设先行于抗争——抗争瘫痪旧秩序，建设准备新秩序，只抗不建则胜利之日即真空之始；其二，自治的单位最小化——村社共和国'以一村为体，全自足'，去中心化使统治者的撤退不留下权力真空给新的集权者；其三，纲领就是教材——每项建设都在训练自治能力，独立日的政府不是从天而降而是从十几年村社实践里长出来的。方法论签名：别只拆旧房子——边拆边在原址砌新屋的地基；自由不是被授予的，是被每日建设出来的。
modes.definition_en: Define independence as a deliverable present rather than a pending future: swaraj is not the capture of Delhi but a self-sufficiency that seventy myriads of villages can begin this very day—khadi production, village self-government bodies, basic education, sanitation, temperance, abolition of untouchability, Hindu-Muslim unity. Gandhi's Constructive Programme enumerated more than a dozen undertakings that require no imperial permission, converting independence from a hanging question on the negotiating table into an accomplished fact inside the villages. Three disciplines carry the mode. First, building precedes breaking: resistance paralyzes the old order while construction prefigures the new one—resist without building, and the day of victory is the first day of vacuum. Second, the unit of self-rule is minimized: the village republic, self-contained at the scale of one village, decentralizes so thoroughly that when the ruler withdraws, no vacuum is left for a new centralizer to inherit—power grows back into a lattice, not a pyramid. Third, the programme is the curriculum: every constructive item trains a capacity of self-rule, so the government of independence day is not parachuted in but grown out of a decade of village practice. Hind Swaraj (1909) supplies the deep critique beneath the programme—against machine civilization and the modern state as such, on the ground that 'it is not the British who have hold of India; it is modern civilization'—which is why liberation must be constructive: expelling the ruler while keeping his machine merely changes the operator. Signature: do not merely demolish the old house—lay the new house's foundation on the same ground while it falls; freedom is not conferred, it is constructed daily.
modes.source_chapter: 《印度自治》（1909，Hind Swaraj）；《建设性纲领》（1941/1945）；《哈里真》周刊村社自治系列
process_zh: 列出可即行清单：凡不须经统治者批准、村民今日即可开始的建设项一律列出并排定优先级
最小单位自治：以村为单位建自治机构与自足经济，使自治能力在统治存续期间即已成型
抗建配对：每场抗争战役配对一项建设任务（抵制洋布配 khadi，反抗税配村社基金），保证破坏性时刻同步生产替代物
交接即验收：独立/政权更替之日，以村庄自治机构的成熟度验收独立成色——权力真空留给谁，独立就是谁
process_en: List the immediately-doable: enumerate every constructive item needing no ruler's permission and rank it—what villagers can start today
Minimize the unit: build village-level self-government and self-sufficient economy so capacity matures while the ruler still reigns
Pair resistance with construction: each campaign carries a paired build task (boycott foreign cloth, spin khadi; refuse taxes, fund the village)—destruction moments must also produce substitutes
Verify at handover: measure independence by the maturity of village institutions—whom the power vacuum goes to is what independence becomes
modes.key_quote_zh: 独立不是接管旧机器，而是让机器停转之前，村庄已学会自己发电。
modes.key_quote_en: Independence is not inheriting the old machine—it is the villages already generating their own power before the machine stops.
representative_cases_zh: 村社自治实践（1920s-1940s）：国大党在数千村庄建立潘查亚特式自治与 khadi 中心，1947年权力交接时印度基层并非真空——建设纲领是'政权可承接性'的预先工程
《印度自治》（1909）：'宗主撤走而机器留下只是换操作员'的论断，使建设性纲领有了哲学根：解放必须连'文明机器'一起重新设计
反例警示：尼赫鲁与安贝德卡的双重批评——尼赫鲁嫌村社经济浪漫化（无法工业化），安贝德卡斥'村庄是地方主义与偏见之渊'，崇村庄可能固化村社内部压迫；建设纲领需与工业化及社会改革议题对表，否则自治可能成为旧结构的防腐剂
representative_cases_en: Village republics, 1920s-40s: panchayat-style bodies and khadi centers in thousands of villages meant the 1947 handover found no vacuum at the base—the programme as pre-engineering of governability

Hind Swaraj, 1909: 'expel the ruler, keep his machine, and you have only changed the operator'—the philosophical root making liberation constructive: the machine of civilization itself must be redesigned

Counterexample: the twin critiques of Nehru (village economy romantic, cannot industrialize) and Ambedkar (the village is a den of localism and prejudice; worshipping it cements internal oppression)—the constructive programme must be benchmarked against industrialization and social reform, or self-rule becomes a preservative of the old structure

modes.definition_zh: 把升级从情绪的洪水改造成刻度的阶梯：请愿→不合作→公民抗命→拒税，每一级都有明确触发条件、训练门槛与可撤回设计；同时每级战役都要选一个'符号当量'极高的靶子——盐（人人可制却被垄断）、布（人人可织却被禁）、登记证（人格的侮辱性标签）——让一次行动同时是战役、教科书与头条。要害有三：其一，符号选靶先于军事逻辑——靶子不必最致命，但必须最可叙事：一把海盐使全球读者三秒读懂'凭什么我制盐犯法'；其二，升级刻度公开——对手与群众都知道下一级是什么、由什么触发，这既约束己方情绪、也向对手发出可控性证明；其三，演的是'不义之法的荒谬'——盐长征385公里不攻击任何设施，全程只是步行与制盐，荒谬感（政府对步行者镇压）本身就是弹药。方法论签名：弱者没有兵力，但有刻度与符号——刻度使升级可控，符号使一次行动顶一万次广播。
modes.definition_en: Convert escalation from a flood of emotion into a ruled ladder: petition, then non-cooperation, then civil disobedience, then tax refusal—each rung with explicit trigger conditions, training thresholds, and retractable design; and at every rung choose a target of maximal symbolic equivalence—salt (anyone can make it, yet it is a monopoly), cloth (anyone can weave it, yet it is banned), the registration certificate (a label of degraded personhood)—so a single action is simultaneously a campaign, a textbook, and a headline. Three disciplines govern the ladder. First, symbolic selection precedes military logic: the target need not be the most damaging but must be the most narratable—one pinch of salt let every reader on earth grasp in three seconds 'why is it a crime to make my own salt.' Second, the scale is public: opponent and public alike know what the next rung is and what triggers it—this disciplines one's own base against emotional surges and proves to the adversary that the movement is a controlled instrument, which paradoxically strengthens the demand for settlement. Third, what is staged is the absurdity of the unjust law: the 385-kilometer march attacked no installation—walking and salt-making were the whole of it—and the absurdity of the state marching police against walkers was itself the ammunition, converting repression into publicity with every blow. Compare the insurrectionary playbook, where escalation is a secret and targets are chosen for damage; Gandhi publishes the escalation and chooses targets for meaning. Signature: the weak have no troops, but they have a scale and a symbol—the scale keeps escalation controllable, and the symbol makes one action worth ten thousand broadcasts.
modes.source_chapter: 1930年盐长征全程记录（《青年印度》连载）；1920年非合作运动升级公告；1930-04-05丹迪制盐与甘地致总督埃尔文信
process_zh: 立阶梯：写明请愿→不合作→公民抗命→拒税的完整刻度、各级触发条件与训练门槛，并公开
选符号靶：在各级选'人人可做却被禁止/人人可懂却被垄断'的靶子，使行动自带可传播性
演荒谬：行动设计以'展示法律之荒谬'为中心（步行制盐、公开焚证），让镇压成为对我方叙事的免费广告
控节奏：以对手反应与群众训练度为节奏器，升级只沿刻度推进，可上亦可撤——情绪不进入决策链
process_en: Publish the ladder: write out petition → non-cooperation → civil disobedience → tax refusal with triggers and training gates, and make it public
Pick symbolic targets: at each rung choose what 'anyone can do yet is banned / anyone understands yet is monopolized,' so the action carries its own broadcast
Stage the absurdity: design actions around exhibiting the law's absurdity (marching to make salt, burning certificates in public)—repression becomes free advertising for our narrative
Control the tempo: advance only along the scale, keyed to the opponent's response and the base's training—capable of advance, capable of withdrawal; emotion stays out of the decision chain
modes.key_quote_zh: 升级要有刻度，行动要有符号——刻度管住自己人，符号撬动全世界。
modes.key_quote_en: Escalation needs a scale, action needs a symbol—the scale disciplines our own, the symbol moves the world.
representative_cases_zh: 盐长征（1930）：先公开致信总督预告犯法，再385公里步行，丹迪一把海盐触发全国抗法——刻度、符号、荒谬感三要素的合订本，使印度问题成为全球头条并逼出圆桌会议
南非焚证（1908-）：登记证集中焚烧这一符号动作，把'身份羞辱'翻转为'尊严宣言'——符号选靶在运动最弱小时就已完成验证
反例警示：升级失控即自毁——若群众跳过刻度直接暴力（乔里·乔拉），对手获得'恢复秩序'的正当叙事，运动二十年积累的道义高位一次清空；刻度公开的最大功能正是防己方跳级
representative_cases_en: The Salt March, 1930: a public letter announcing the crime, 385 kilometers of walking, one pinch of salt at Dandi triggering nationwide defiance—the ladder, the symbol, and the absurdity in a single volume; India became a global headline and a Round Table Conference followed

Certificate burning, South Africa, 1908: the ritual bonfire of registration certificates flipped a badge of humiliation into a declaration of dignity—symbolic targeting validated while the movement was at its weakest

Counterexample: escalation out of control is self-destruction—when crowds skip rungs into violence (Chauri Chaura), the adversary gains the 'restore order' narrative and twenty years of moral altitude are cleared at once; the scale's chief function is precisely to prevent one's own side from jumping rungs

modes.definition_zh: 把'真理'从占有物改写为渐近线：甘地自题其自传为'我体验真理的故事（My Experiments with Truth）'——他不宣称掌握真理，只宣称在持续实验；每一场运动、每一次绝食、每一条戒律（不食、不语日、缄默祈祷）都是一次可复盘的实验，结论写进公开档案，失败照录。这为道德行动者提供了科学家的迭代纪律：假设（此法能唤醒良知）→实验（盐长征/绝食）→观测（对手与群众反应）→修正（中止、改期、改法）。要害有三：其一，实验者不豁免于实验——甘地以自己为第一实验对象（饮食、节欲、沉默），先在最小系统验证再放大到社会；其二，公开档案使迭代可审计——《印度舆论》《青年印度》连续刊载实验记录，成功与失败同权入档；其三，手段-目的同一性是实验的约束项——任何'好结果可以不择手段'的捷径都被禁入，因为手段会毒化样本。方法论签名：真理不是答辩时才拿出的一劳永逸的答案，而是像盐一样每日重新制取的必需品——我唯一宣称的是：我仍在实验。
modes.definition_en: Rewrite truth from a possession into an asymptote: Gandhi titled his autobiography The Story of My Experiments with Truth—he claims no mastery of truth, only a continuing experimental practice; every campaign, every fast, every vow (dietary discipline, day of silence, prayer) is a reviewable experiment whose results are written into the public record, failures included with equal rights. This gives the moral actor the scientist's iterative discipline: hypothesis (this method can awaken conscience), experiment (the Salt March, a fast), observation (how opponent and masses respond), correction (suspension, postponement, redesign). Three disciplines define the practice. First, the experimenter is never exempt from the experiment: Gandhi ran the protocol on himself first—diet, celibacy, silence—validating at the scale of one body before scaling to society, so the movement's methods arrive pre-tested rather than preached. Second, the public archive makes iteration auditable: Indian Opinion and Young India carried running logs in which success and failure were filed with the same weight—readers could watch the method learn, which is precisely what made the method transferable to King, Mandela, and beyond. Third, means-ends unity is the experiment's constraint set: no shortcut of 'good ends may use any means' is admissible, because tainted means poison the sample—the method is scientific precisely because it refuses contaminated data. Where dogma freezes a movement around fixed conclusions, the experimental mode keeps it revisable: Gandhi changed positions (on empire after Amritsar, on caste practice, on machinery) and said so openly, taking the reputational cost of revision in exchange for staying truthful. Signature: truth is not a final answer produced for the defense; it is a necessity re-made daily, like salt—the only thing I claim is that I am still experimenting.
modes.source_chapter: 《我体验真理的故事》（1927-1929，题名即纲领）；《印度舆论》《青年印度》实验记录连载；《哈里真》晚年修正文章
process_zh: 最小系统先行：任何方法先在自己身体与生活上实验（饮食、沉默、戒律），验证后再放大到运动
档案化迭代：连续公开记录每次实验的目的、过程、结果——成功失败同权入档，供他者复制与批评
定期复盘修正：以既定节奏（日记、周刊、年终总结）复盘假设偏差，公开宣布修正而不掩饰改口
约束项常设：手段-目的同一性作为实验红线——凡靠污染手段得到的'成功'一律不计入证据
process_en: Minimum system first: run every method on your own body and life (diet, silence, vows) before scaling it to the movement
Archive the iteration: log every experiment's aim, process, and result in public—success and failure filed equally, copyable and criticizable by others
Review on rhythm: re-examine hypothesis drift on a fixed cadence (journal, weekly, year-end) and announce corrections openly rather than disguising reversals
Keep the constraint set: means-ends unity as the red line of experimentation—any 'success' obtained through contaminated means is excluded from the evidence
modes.key_quote_zh: 我不过是在实验真理——结论永远待修正，而修正本身必须公开。
modes.key_quote_en: I am only experimenting with truth—the conclusion is always open to revision, and the revision itself must be public.
representative_cases_zh: 《我体验真理的故事》（1927-1929）：以'实验'命名一生——自陈饮食、节欲、沉默诸项实验的失败与修正，把政治领袖写成实验记录员，文类即方法
立场的公开修正（1919-1947）：阿姆利则惨案后从'效忠帝国'转向不合作，晚年公开修正种姓与机械观——每次改口都附理由与代价，迭代而非崩溃
反例警示：实验法依赖诚实档案——若实验者只发表成功案例，方法学即退化为营销学；甘地的可信度恰恰建立在'失败照录'上，这一纪律被省略则整个模式失效
representative_cases_en: The autobiography, 1927-29: a life named as experiment—dietary, celibacy, and silence experiments with failures and corrections on record; the genre itself is the method

Public revision of positions, 1919-47: from loyalty to empire (before Amritsar) to non-cooperation, and late-life corrections on caste and machinery—every reversal carried reasons and costs, iteration rather than collapse

Counterexample: the method dies with dishonest archives—publish only wins and 'experimentation' degrades into marketing; Gandhi's authority rests precisely on recording failures, and omitting that discipline voids the whole mode
